requirements.title: Table 9.1 defines subscript order value formulas through rank 15
requirements.definition: Table 9.1 gives the subscript order value formula: for rank 1, 1 + (s1 - j1); for rank 2, 1 + (s1 - j1) + (s2 - j2) * d1; for rank 3, add (s3 - j3) * d2 * d1; and by the displayed pattern through rank 15, add for dimension n the term (sn - jn) multiplied by d(n-1) down through d1. The table extraction was checked against layout text; the rank-15 row's extracted text places one multiplication sign ambiguously, so the catalogue records the intended visual row as a pending review point rather than using extraction alone.

review_rationale: Independent source review in doc/source_audits/batch_091.json reads all four original 9.5.3.3 units, including Table9.1 and both notes, and independently derives the subscript order value. The catalogue transcription is correct: the value is1 plus the sum over dimensions of (s_i minus j_i) multiplied by the product of the preceding dimension sizes, with d_i equal to MAX(k_i minus j_i plus1,0). Table9.1 is subdivided per rank row and accounted on its own terms. The automatic extraction of the rank-15 row misplaces one multiplication sign and emits a stray fragment; the catalogue records that ambiguity explicitly instead of resolving it silently, and the reviewer confirms the recorded statement is honest and the intended final term correct. Array element order is derived from the table rather than from storage addresses or processor traversal order. All eight facets remain pending source plans; no case, execution, oracle or fixture approval is created.
